caption: A silk scarf draped over the back of a chair slides off and pools in soft folds on the floor.

sa.check: A silk scarf is draped over the back of a chair.
It pools in soft folds on the floor.
The slide comes first and the pooling follows.

pc.expect: It slips down following the chair's shape, falls, and lands.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or stays in the air.

pc.expect: It falls as a limp sheet and lands in loose folds.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or lands flat as a square; or tears.
It rises again; or slides on; or re-drapes itself.

pc.expect: It lies on the floor, not through it.
pc.fail: It passes through the floor; or through the chair; or the chair passes through it.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The scarf's colour and the chair stay the same.
pc.fail: The scarf changes colour; or the chair changes; or the room rearranges.
